title: moluchia frutescens
intro: Moluchia frutescens, commonly known as Wild Passionflower, is a tropical plant species belonging to the Passifloraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The health benefits of Moluchia frutescens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, exhibiting therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. These bioactive constituents contribute to its therapeutic potential in treating various health conditions, including insomnia, anxiety, and muscle spasms.
